title: ARLOVI | Complete Platform UX & Native Application Specification
status: Normative product design handoff; implementation unverified
naming_note: Arlovi is a working name subject to trademark/domain clearance
mandate: Complete platform: no MVP or deferred feature assumption
design_tokens: Persistent org/context, command search, status, notification and profile actions; 56px permitted for constrained width
Collapses to icon rail of 64px or mobile sheet
Application routes and user preferences; overlays in constrained windows
Resizes where appropriate; overlay or bottom sheet below 1200px
Sticky within editor; contextual overflow at narrow width
Only when needed for editor coordinates, save state or runtime details
Professional tables with user-controlled density; never shrink fundamental text on mobile
Contrast and hierarchy without excessive vertical waste
Fluid clamp with room for actions and localization
44px preferred main pointer/touch target; larger where needed
Constrained reading max width 720–840px; canvases and tables fill available space
Compact density may reduce to 12px; preserve hit targets
Independent scroll regions and mobile keyboard/safe-area handling
responsive_breakpoints: single primary column; bottom navigation; inspector/fullscreen sheets
1–2 content columns; compact navigation; touch-first controls
64px rail; panels overlay or toggle; constrained toolbars
multi-pane specialist tools; maximal reading widths remain bounded
global_surfaces: Global header
Org/workspace switch, breadcrumb, universal search, active-work indicator, notifications and profile. Show selected org distinctly; changes cannot leave old-org resources in context.
Keyboard navigation, focus after switching, command search, accessible status.
Application sidebar
Active route, app grouping, pinned sections, badges, collapsed rail, scroll, resizing and role visibility. Local app nav appears only when useful.
Persist per-user collapse state; route changes preserve page filters where appropriate.
Tabs
Each tab has unique content model and URI/query state as appropriate; roving keyboard focus; scrollable overflow and visible selected indicator.
Preserve unsaved edits and warn before destructive tab transition.
Context inspector
Record/element/agent detail at 300–360px desktop; user-controlled resize, close, focus return.
Mobile sheet with heading, reachable close, nontrapping when nonmodal.
Drawer
Contextual details, forms and record inspector; appropriate overlay/backdrop and URL state.
Escape closes when safe, unsaved changes prompt, focus restored, swipe behavior not exclusive.
Modal
Only for focused consequential decisions or scoped multistep form. Meaningful title, primary/secondary actions, explicit side effects.
Focus trap, return focus, disabled conditions explained, no nested modal chains.
Popover
Anchored controls, shortcuts or small selection. Auto-flip against viewport, high-contrast focus.
Dismiss on Escape/outside click unless state requires deliberate submission.
Toolbar
Grouped commands by relevance, selected tool state, shortcut hints, overflow strategy.
Touch and keyboard equivalents; unsupported action visibly disabled with reason.
Table
Saved column settings, sort/filter/search, virtualization, row select and bulk actions, stable IDs.
Numbers aligned and tabular; mobile accessible cards/alternate where feasible.
Board
Visible card identity, owner, state, order and drop zones; moving can trigger explicit rules only.
Move via menu/keyboard as alternative to drag; reject invalid transition clearly.
Calendar
Resource/timezone display, available holds vs confirmed bookings, conflicts, accessible agenda.
DST boundary handling, recurrence edits, drag alternative and period navigation.
Canvas
Select/pan/zoom/undo/redo; layers hierarchy; coordinates; device preview; snapping; source/edit fidelity.
No forced rasterization; alternate object list and keyboard object transforms.
Timeline
Time-scale, ordering, dependencies, clip/task/event selection, zoom and snapping.
Access via chronological list; handle timezone/frame precision and move confirmation.
Rich editor
Autosave with explicit save state; comments, versions, formatting, AI diff, accurate export.
Conflicting edits resolved and version history immutable.
AI composer
Natural text, voice, attachments, mentions, context scope, task type and action confirmation.
External sources untrusted; inference never bypasses permission or user review.
Notification
Typed priority, source, grouped updates, read/acknowledged/resolved, target deep-link, preference and expiry.
Read never equals approved; avoid toast storm and hidden critical incidents.
Approval sheet
Identifies requesting agent/human, exact action, scope, affected records, reversibility, cost, constraints, expiry.
Server-side plan-hash and version check before execution.
Action receipt
Status of requested/accepted/pending/verified/failed action, provider resource ID, evidence, actor and grant.
Timed-out irreversible action reconciled before any retry.
Error banner
Clear cause, scope of impact, confirmed actions, proposed recovery and owner.
No fake success; persistent recovery entry for long-lived incidents.
File upload
Drag/drop and picker, progress, type/size limits, security scan, parsing, source classification and proposed use.
Untrusted content never becomes agent authority; cancellation/failed chunk recovery.
Search & command
Unified result groups, saved recents, keyboard activation, command preview and cross-org boundary.
Resource-level permissions checked on every result and action.

dashboard: Start with one-line summary, then top decisions, metrics, work and source links.
3-4 columns wide; 2 columns tablet; 1 column narrow, card reorder via menu.
directory: Search/filter/sort, results count, quick inspection, pagination/virtualization.
Full list desktop, card rows mobile; filters in drawer.
table: Column presets, server filtering, sorting, pinned identity, bulk selection.
Horizontal table where necessary plus mobile record-card alternative.
record: Entity detail with actions and inspector
Sticky identity header, authoritative fields, related objects, chronological audit.
Inspector turns into drawer; primary action stays discoverable.
chat: Message list, composer, mentions, source context, attachments.
Single-thread mobile; sidebar as sheet; composer above keyboard.
graph: Pan/zoom, focus, selection, relationships, accessible list counterpart.
Canvas with collapsible side panels; accessible list on mobile.
board: Cards show identity, owner, status; dragging has button-based equivalent.
Swipe/horizontal lanes on mobile plus full list view.
calendar: Local time, resources, availability and conflict preview.
Agenda default on narrow screens; time-grid when feasible.
editor: Document/canvas/grid occupies largest area; contextual tools, autosave and undo.
Toolbars collapse; inspectors become accessible sheets; no text miniaturization.
canvas: Spatial canvas with layers and properties
Selection, pan, zoom, snapping, objects and edit history.
Canvas remains functional, tool panels use sheets; alternate object list.
media: Media preview, timeline/transcript, accessible controls and consent.
Essential transport controls visible; auxiliary views behind tabs.
admin: Hierarchy of controls, preview consequences, sensitive action review.
Stack settings sections; avoid modal chains; keep submit visible.
settings: Categories, field-level explanations, immediate and deferred save states.
Single column with persistent category search.
report: Title, period/source, key conclusion, charts/tables, methods and export.
Charts reflow, tables use accessible alternate; formulas remain inspectable.
list: Status filters, owner, actions, triage and counts.
Compact list or card rows and bottom action bar.
builder: Palette, edit surface, property inspector, simulation and publish controls.
Builder on tablet/desktop; structured form alternative on mobile.
wizard: Progress, draft resume, clear requirements, confirmations and alternative pathways.
Single column, visible Back/Continue and keyboard navigation.
timeline: Time scale, dependencies, state, event evidence and navigation.

Editable structure, brand rules, asset licensing, provider confirmation.

Atomic slot holds, timezone, cancellation policy and receipts.

risks: Cross-organization or cross-brand leakage in retrieval, caches, search, file previews and notifications
Indirect prompt injection through customer uploads, email, external webpages, model outputs or connector tool responses
Non-idempotent irreversible actions retried after network timeout
Unbounded AI delegation, token use, concurrency or external media-render spend
Approval based on stale plan version or modified external account
Autonomous accounting/payroll/legal/employment actions outside human signoff
Conflicting or stale canonical data leading to a wrong business recommendation
Inaccessible canvas/drag UI without keyboard/single-pointer equivalent
Duplicate customer identities after external sync with different providers
Incorrect time zones, DST transitions or locale-sensitive money/date operations
Unverified business outcomes wrongly labelled complete
Insufficient native feature parity creating false claims of replacing specialist tools
Provider rate limits, licensing, outages and schema evolution
Lost work from autosave race, conflicting edits or mobile navigation
No suitable graceful degradation for partial connectivity or device limitations
